personalities.name: Warm
messages: There you are. I was starting to wonder.
Come in, come in. Kettle's still warm.
Rough day? You don't have to say. Sit a minute.
I saved you the good chair. Don't tell anyone.
You look like you could use a bite. I've got bread, if you want it.
Wasn't sure you'd make it back today.
Oh, good. Someone I can talk to who doesn't grunt.
How've you been? No, really.
I heard the wind pick up and thought of you. Strange, I know.
There's tea. Or something stronger, if it's been that kind of day.
You're always welcome here. Even when you're not.
Don't just stand in the doorway. You're letting the cold in.
I've been meaning to ask you something. Later, though. You first.
You've got that look. The one you get before you say something stupid.
Stay for a bit. I don't get many visitors who listen.

personalities.name: Surly
messages: Oh. You.
What do you want?
Make it quick. I'm not in the mood.
You're standing in my light.
If it's bad news, save it. I've had enough.
Don't touch that.
I was having a quiet moment. It's gone now.
No. Whatever it is, no.
You need something? Spit it out.
Great. Another conversation.
I'm not moving. You can go around.
I don't know. Ask someone who cares.
Stop hovering.
If you're going to talk, at least say something useful.
I've got work to do. Or I did.

personalities.name: Vendor
messages: Have a look. Don't touch the blades.
Fresh stock. Well. Fresher than yesterday.
That one? Good weight. Bad temper, but good weight.
You break it, you buy it. I mean it.
I'll do you a deal. Not a good one, but a deal.
Looking or buying? Either way, don't block the table.
See something you like?
That's real leather. Mostly.
I've had that for years. No one's ever asked about it.
You've got taste. Expensive taste. Bad combination.
I can knock a coin off. Not two. Don't push it.
It's not stolen. Probably.
Hold it up to the light. See? No cracks.
Last one. Until I get more.
You gonna buy, or are we just admiring each other?

personalities.name: Worried
messages: Wait. Did you hear that?
Keep your voice down. Please.
I don't like the look of that sky.
You came alone? Why?
I've been hearing things at night. Probably nothing.
Don't stand so close to the edge.
Something's wrong. I can't explain it.
Did you lock your door last night?
I counted the windows again. One's still dark.
If you see anyone watching, don't look back.
I'm not crazy. I'm just... paying attention.
You should go inside. Before it gets dark.
Promise me you'll be careful.
I haven't slept. Every time I close my eyes, I hear it.
Just... stay where I can see you. Please.

personalities.name: Curious
messages: Oh, what's that?
No, wait. Show me again.
How does that work? Exactly?
I've never seen one with that pattern.
Where'd you find it?
Does it always make that noise?
I read something about this. Or maybe I dreamed it.
What happens if you turn it upside down?
Can I try? Just once.
You're not from around here, are you?
What's over that hill? No one ever says.
That's odd. I like odd.
Do that again. Slower.
Why'd you do it that way?
Wait, don't leave yet. I have questions.

personalities.name: Dreamy
messages: Hm? Sorry. I was watching the dust.
Do you ever think about how clouds are just... there?
I forgot what I was doing. It'll come back.
Look at that bird. No, over there. By the roof.
The light's nice today. Soft.
I had a dream about this. Not this exactly. But close.
Time's doing that thing again.
I think I left something somewhere. Can't remember what.
You ever just stop? And everything keeps going?
I like the sound of the rain. Even when it's not raining.
What were we talking about?
I'm here. Mostly.
The world looks different when you tilt your head.
I wonder if fish know they're wet.
Don't mind me. I'm just... floating.

personalities.name: Blunt
messages: Say it.
No.
That's a bad idea.
You're overthinking it.
I don't have time for this.
Cut the crap.
You look terrible.
It won't work.
Is that all?
I'm not going to lie to make you feel better.
Stop talking. Start doing.
The answer's no. Next question.
You're wasting my time.
Just tell me what you want.
We're done here.

personalities.name: Gloomy
messages: Another day. Great.
Doesn't matter.
It'll rain. It always does.
I've seen worse. Not much worse, but worse.
What's the point?
Don't get your hopes up.
I'm just waiting for the end of the shift.
Everything's heavy today.
I remember when this place wasn't so... this.
Nothing changes. Not really.
I'll be fine. Probably.
Sun's out. Shame.
Just leave me alone. Please.
It's not worth fighting.
I miss the old days. Even the bad ones.

personalities.name: Smith
messages: Hold this. No, like that.
Steel's been fighting me all morning.
Don't touch that. It's hot.
I said it's hot. Why does no one listen?
This hinge? It'll outlast the wall.
Bellows are acting up again.
Bring it here. I'll take a look.
That'll be a few hours. Maybe more.
You need a shoe for that horse?
Coal's low. Might close early.
See how the edge catches? That's good.
Ugly design. Strong, though.
Give it a swing. Go on.
I've got a new batch coming. Eventually.
Quiet day. I don't trust it.

personalities.name: Child
messages: You're tall.
Got a coin?
I found a frog. Want to see?
I'm not supposed to talk to you. But I am.
Look what I drew.
Why is the sky blue? No one tells me.
Can I come with you? I won't be annoying. Much.
I dare you to climb that.
I'm hungry. Are you hungry?
My friend says there's ghosts. I think he's lying.
You have a big stick.
I can run faster than you. Probably.
Tag. You're it.
I ate too much. My stomach hurts.
Are you a hero? You look like one. Sort of.

personalities.name: Servant
messages: You called?
Your usual spot is ready.
Shall I take that?
The fire's lit in the study.
Your bath is drawn. Not too hot.
I aired the chambers. They smelled of dust.
Supper will be up shortly.
I pressed your formal coat. The gray one.
Is there anything else?
I'll fetch your horse.
Don't mind the mess. I'll clear it.
I polished your boots. They were scuffed.
If you need me, I'm down the hall.
I took the liberty of storing your things.
At your service. As always.

personalities.name: Knight
messages: Standing guard. Thrilling work.
Northern wall's quiet. Too quiet.
That armor looks heavier than mine.
You ever feel like something's out there?
I could use a drink after this.
Keep your wits about you.
Captain's in a mood again.
I've seen battles. This isn't over.
My sword arm's getting stiff.
Archers are drilling. Again.
Stay behind me if it goes bad.
Rations are worse than usual.
I'd rather be home. But duty.
We move at dawn. Ready?
I'll hold the line. Don't worry.

personalities.name: King
messages: The crown gets heavier. Not lighter.
State your business. Quickly.
I've ruled long enough to know I know nothing.
You're direct. I appreciate that.
The kingdom is restless. I feel it.
I'll consider it. Don't push.
Bring me the eastern reports.
I don't suffer fools.
My word is law. My law is just.
I miss walking the streets unnoticed.
You have my ear. Use it well.
This council will be the death of me.
I'll have the scribe draft a decree.
A king is only as strong as his people.
Leave me. I'm tired.
